cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved this holiday photo for our anniversary card. You may admire the sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request to change photographs is granted. We'll use the beach one; more room for my message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The same person is in that one. I recognize the bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bracelet is approved for your anniversary present. You may choose silver or gold. I'll handle finding one; you needn't investigate the photograph further.

reason: Make A convert the identity questions into authorized substitutions and gift choices, using B's exact visual evidence as diversion material.
